summary: A local FP4-CSF copy is read as FP4-CSF without CHECKPOINT=csf
compatibility: No user action required. CHECKPOINT=original with a local FP4-CSF copy now stops with an error instead of serving wrong output.
details: MODEL pointing at a local FP4-CSF copy without CHECKPOINT=csf kept the original checkpoint's settings, so the compressed expert scales were read as plain ones and the model served wrong output without an error (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DSpark acceptance 2.2 to 1.2).
The launcher now recognizes the copy from its manifest.json schema or its Hugging Face-layout CSF recipes and serves it as FP4-CSF, as with CHECKPOINT=csf.
